work: Whereas the Lawes published by the Honoured General Court ... do require all Tow
heading: Order of the General Court to the Constables, 1668

items.text: Teach your children to read the English tongue perfectly, have knowledge of the capital laws, and be taught an orthodox catechism.
items.citation: Order of the General Court to the Constables, 1668
items.quote: all Children and Youth under family Government, be taught to Read perfectly the English Tongue, have knowledge of the Capital Lawes, and be taught some Orthodox Catechisme

items.text: Bring them up to honest employment profitable to themselves and the commonwealth.
items.citation: Order of the General Court to the Constables, 1668
items.quote: and that they be brought up to some honest imployment profitable to themselves and the Common Wealth

items.text: Serve your parents and be subject to their commands and discipline; do not live apart from family government.
items.citation: Order of the General Court to the Constables, 1668
items.quote: do not serve their Parents, or Masters, as Children, Apprentices, hired Servants, or journey men, ought to do, being subject to their Commands and Discipline

items.text: Serve your master and be subject to his commands and discipline as a servant or apprentice ought.
items.citation: Order of the General Court to the Constables, 1668
items.quote: do not serve their Parents, or Masters, as Children, Apprentices, hired Servants, or journey men, ought to do, being subject to their Commands and Discipline
